matching_pages_notes: Original PDF pages 231-240 were rendered at 180 dpi and all 460 printed rows were compared with immutable source records for row order, indexed name and initials, rank, private-identifier column occupancy, box, notes, and archive location. All ten pages matched the extraction and no correction was needed. Repeated or near-matching rows remain distinct, including John Jett and Gust Jevas pairs; Eilert Johannesen/Johannessen; Fred J/W Johansen; same-name and near-name Johnson, Johnston, and Jones clusters; Edward H/J Judels; Tvonimir/Zvonimir Jurisic; Medard K Kalich/Medard Kalick; and duplicate-name Baruch D and Jacob Kaplan rows with different private-identifier occupancy or values. The review preserves truncated printed forms, literal capitalization and misspellings such as Jessen-Schmi, Johannnesen, Laura p Johnson, Haold and Katehryn Johnston, Geoge Jonas, Ricahrd Joyce, Tvonimir Jurisic, Kalogeropoulo, Kammenzind, and the special Kalxon no-first-name row; foreign and service notes; out-of-sequence boxes and locations; and column shifts exactly as printed. Private identifiers are not included in this bundle or public assets.
